resources.string: Shows the effect on top of every app. FlexTounch uses an accessibility service only to know where you tap. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere: the app has no internet permission.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out on Android 13+: App info → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings.
Open “Installed apps” and switch on FlexTounch
This device cannot open that screen
Touch effects on your home screen, with drag trails. Works on every Android version, no special access needed.
Touch the screen and watch water, orbs and lightning come alive.
Draws a touch effect where you tap. FlexTounch does not read, store or send any screen content.
